messages.text: I am looking for a 16” glob with a wooden base.
Searched the catalog · 16 inch desktop globe wooden base

The National Geographic Nicollet 16" Illuminated Desk Globe is a great fit — it sits on a handcrafted teak hardwood base, carries raised relief topography with over 4,000 place names, and switches on to reveal hidden ocean-depth and terrain detail when lit. Shipping is free on that one. If you'd rather have it stand on the floor instead of a desk, the Commander II 16" Antique Ocean Floor Globe has a solid hardwood convertible pedestal that adjusts between floor and tabletop height.

Is this one meant for a desk, or are you picturing it standing on the floor?

The National Geographic Nicollet 16" Illuminated Desk Globe is exactly right then — it's built as a desk piece, with that handcrafted teak hardwood base giving it real presence, and the illumination is a nice touch for evening use since it reveals the deep-sea topography when lit. You'll find it under that exact name in the site search, ready to add to your cart.
